newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 2.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 2.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to larger ships on Wednesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
Smaller ships were warned of high wind speeds and waves along the Pacific coast of Baja California and Sonora states. Puerto Penasco was closed to smaller tourist and fishing ships.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, the Gulf of Mexico and the Caribbean.

Weak cold front along coast of Baja California and Sonora states drawing lowering temperatures and possible isolated rains. Maximum winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) and waves five to seven feet high.
Isolated light rains along coasts of Tamaulipas and Yucatan peninsula, with clear skies along most of remainder of coast. Maximum winds at 10 to 15 knots.
Isolated clouds and hot with moderate winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
